name: Vampire Hunter Creature (CR +1 or +2)
body:
A vampire hunter creature gains a vampiric focus. It also gains some technique feats, tracking, and the relentless ability. A vampire hunter creature’s CR increases by 2 if the creature has 10 or more HD.

Quick Rules

Choose either Str or Dex. The creature gains +2 on all rolls based on the chosen ability score (and +2 to AC if Dex is chosen). The creature gains a technique feat as a bonus feat (if the creature has 10 or more HD, choose two more bonus feats from those listed as combat feats or as vampire hunting technique feats).

The creature also gains one vampiric focus, treating its hit dice as its vampire hunter level for the purpose of determining that vampiric focus’ benefits. Lastly, the creature gains track (and relentless if the creature has 10 or more HD).

Rebuild Rules

Defensive Abilities relentless (if the creature has 10 or more HD); Special Attacks vampiric focus (choosing only one, treats its hit dice as its vampire hunter levels; Special Qualities track; Ability Scores +4 Strength or Dexterity; Feats one technique feat as a bonus feat (if the creature has 10 or more HD, choose two more bonus feats from those listed as combat feats or as vampire hunting technique feats).
